_about: The CHECK ids every sandbox run MUST print, per section. An id that never printed becomes `CHECK missing_<id> FAIL expected CHECK line never printed` in all_checks.txt (verdict.py guard), so a crashed or skipped step is red, never a count of 0 failed. Lists are added up: `all`, then `tools` or `no_tools` (the app ships a *_lc_tools module, or expected_hosts.json says tools_module optional and it ships none), then `unix` (Linux and macOS) or `windows`, and `windows_tools` on Windows when the app has tools. Ids whose name carries a variable part (4_cli_case_NN_..., 4n_notebook_form_runs_...) and the Napari, Fiji, QuPath and Playground-extras checks are not listed: their own steps print a FAIL when the driver printed no CHECK line. The update test (old_tag) is not listed either. Read by verdict.py; tests/test_release_sandbox_verdict.py keeps it in step with the workflow and the check scripts.
